title: Sales traps to avoid
objectives: Name three sales traps and the compliant alternative.
Say why exclusivity is never a reason to invest.
body_md:
Sales traps to avoid: moving a client up the ladder because the commission is higher. Pitching an AIF's best-case return without showing the lock-in and fees. Using exclusivity (“only for select investors”) as the reason to invest.

> **Talk-track:** “The right product isn't the most exclusive one; it's the one that fits your goals, timeline and comfort with risk.”

> **Investor takeaway:** Exclusive doesn't mean better. Choose by fit, cost and liquidity.
example: Pitching “only for select investors”: exclusivity is marketing, not suitability — fit, cost and liquidity decide.
say: The right product fits goals, timeline and comfort with risk.
Never move a client up the ladder for higher commission.
never: Move clients up the ladder for higher commission.
Pitch best-case returns without lock-in and fees.
